game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.121 (Ziibiing opens on phones again) and 0.8.120: each home has its own chest. What you put in a Ziibiing chest stays in Ziibiing's chests, what you put in an Ashvale chest stays in Ashvale's, and anything new from the arcade shows in both until you take it. Gold still on its way from the Bank counts in your chest at once. Chess pieces no longer jump back after a move, the card table shows all five board cards in a row, and ASHVALE has its own tab icon. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
